name: @cmodjs/cli
description: Claude Mod Manager: install, try, build, check, and publish Claude Code mods.

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/cmod-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/cmod-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/cmod-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/cmod-linux-arm64
